search.subtitle: Find exact words in the knowledge base and your documents. Own BM25 index, no AI involved.
search.label: Search query
search.idleHint: Type at least {{min}} characters. Use "quotes" for an exact phrase and -word to exclude a word.
search.emptyTip: Try fewer words, or switch to “Any word”. Search matches whole words only, with no stemming.
search.rateLimited: Too many searches. Wait a few seconds and try again.
search.indexBuilding: The search index is still being built. Try again in a few seconds.
search.explainBm25: BM25 adds one row per query word: rare words (high idf) count more, repeats (tf) help with diminishing returns, and longer passages are penalised. The rows add up to the score. Collection: {{n}} passages.
search.explainTfidf: TF-IDF multiplies how often the word is in this passage (tf) by how rare it is across all passages (idf). The rows add up to the score. Collection: {{n}} passages.

landing.metaTitle: Mnemonic: study with answers you can verify
landing.metaDescription: Ask your notes. Every answer cites its sources or honestly says it doesn't know, and turns into flashcards.
landing.heroTitle: Ask your notes. Get answers you can verify.
landing.heroSub: Every answer cites its source, or honestly says “not in your materials”. One click turns it into flashcards.
landing.tryHint: Takes under a minute. A ready knowledge base (the FastAPI docs) is waiting for your first question.
landing.mockLabel: Preview of a Mnemonic answer with citations
landing.mockQuestion: How do I enable CORS in FastAPI?
landing.mockAnswer1: Add CORSMiddleware to your app and list the origins you trust in allow_origins
landing.mockAnswer2: Without it, browsers block requests coming from another domain
landing.step1Text: Type a question, or tap an example. The answer streams in.
landing.step2Text: Click a [1] chip to read the exact passage the answer is based on.
landing.step3Text: Turn the answer into flashcards and review them to remember it.
landing.f1Text: Every claim points to a passage you can open. No source, no claim.
landing.f2Text: If the material doesn't cover the question, Mnemonic says so instead of inventing an answer.
landing.f3Text: Keyword (BM25) and meaning-based search work together. “Why this result?” shows the score, term by term.
landing.privacyText: Your chats and documents are private to your account, and you can delete the account any time in Settings. Your question and the passages found are sent to Google's Gemini model to write the answer. We count anonymous events such as “a question was answered” to improve the product, never the text of your questions.
landing.ctaTitle: Ask your first question in under a minute
